# Continue pressing UP to catch the target
# Player at rows 28-29, target at rows 26-27
# Target moving up, player moving up - need to catch it

for i in range(5):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    player = gt = None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O': player = n
        elif n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3: gt = n
    
    red_squares = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R')
    
    if player:
        p_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in player['boundary']])
        p_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in player['boundary']])
        print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: Player pixels={player['pixels']}, cols {p_cols[0]}-{p_cols[-1]}, rows {p_rows[0]}-{p_rows[-1]}")
    else:
        print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: Player None")
    
    if gt:
        g_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in gt['boundary']])
        g_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in gt['boundary']])
        print(f"  Target: cols {g_cols[0]}-{g_cols[-1]}, rows {g_rows[0]}-{g_rows[-1]}")
    else:
        print(f"  Target: None (collected?)")
    
    print(f"  Red squares: {red_squares}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
    if red_squares < 2:
        print("Target collected!")
        break

</function>
